evidence: Cic. de Or. 1.218: nūllā in rē tīrō ac rudis (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Properly a raw recruit, and so any beginner (Lewis & Short); Traupman uses it for a first-year student, male or female.

sources: Lewis & Short: tiro
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 29, checked against the searchable text of the book.
